settings.label: Personal access token
settings.meaning: Reads the account's event types, scheduled events and invitees, books and cancels them, and manages webhook subscriptions. An organization owner's or admin's token covers everyone in the organization; anyone else's covers only their own.
settings.whereToFind: Profile menu › Developer › Personal access tokens › Create personal access token, with the scopes users:read, event_types:read, scheduled_events:read, scheduled_events:write, scheduling_links:write, webhooks:read and webhooks:write. Calendly shows it once. Calendly has no test mode: use a separate Calendly account for test.

settings.label: Webhook signing key
settings.meaning: Checks that a webhook came from Calendly. You choose it, and it's sent to Calendly when the webhook subscription is made.
settings.whereToFind: Any long random string of your own: webhookSubscriptions.create gives it to Calendly as the subscription's signing_key.

operations.name: users.me
operations.purpose: Reads the token's own user, with its URI and its organization's URI, which the other operations take.

operations.name: eventTypes.list
operations.purpose: Lists a user's or an organization's event types, a page at a time.

operations.name: eventTypes.availableTimes
operations.purpose: Lists an event type's open start times in a range of up to 31 days, none of it in the past.

operations.name: scheduledEvents.list
operations.purpose: Lists a user's, a group's or an organization's scheduled events, filtered by status, start time and invitee email, a page at a time.

operations.name: scheduledEvents.cancel
operations.purpose: Cancels a scheduled event, with an optional reason.

operations.name: invitees.list
operations.purpose: Lists a scheduled event's invitees, filtered by status and email, a page at a time.

operations.name: invitees.get
operations.purpose: Reads one invitee: their email, name, answers, tracking, and links to cancel or reschedule.

operations.name: invitees.create
operations.purpose: Books an open start time of an event type for an invitee (the Scheduling API), with Calendly's usual notifications and calendar invites.

operations.name: noShows.create
operations.purpose: Marks an invitee as a no-show.

operations.name: noShows.delete
operations.purpose: Undoes marking an invitee as a no-show.

operations.name: schedulingLinks.create
operations.purpose: Makes a single-use booking link for an event type: it books one event, then stops working.

operations.name: webhookSubscriptions.create
operations.purpose: Subscribes a URL to events for a user, a group or the organization, signed with the webhook signing key.

operations.name: webhookSubscriptions.list
operations.purpose: Lists the organization's, a group's or a user's webhook subscriptions, a page at a time.

signature.description: The header is t=<Unix seconds>,v1=<hex>, where v1 is the hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the subscription's signing key, of t, a period, and the raw request body. Calendly recommends refusing a timestamp more than three minutes old.

events.meaning: Someone booked an event, or rescheduled one (the new booking).
An invitee's booking was canceled, by them or the host, or rescheduled (the old booking, with rescheduled true).
An invitee was marked as a no-show.
An invitee's no-show mark was removed.
Someone submitted a routing form, whether or not they then booked. Organization scope only, and a plan with routing forms.
